payload.raw: Example: citation syntax

payload.highlightedHtml:
// Worker-side: register a custom regex block/inline matcher.
registry.use({
  name: "citation",
  inline: {
    full: /\{cite:(\d+)\}/g,
    start: /\{cite:/g,
    render: ({ match }) => ({ type: "inline", tag: "span", props: { className: "citation", children: `[${match[1]}]` } }),
  },
});
